elements.title: Correlation Heatmap for Variables in Car Crashes Dataset

details.color scale: red gradient from light (low correlation) to dark red (high correlation)
details.notable features: Dark red diagonal from upper left to lower right indicating perfect correlation (1.0) of variables with themselves.

elements.summary: This heatmap visualizes the correlation coefficients between variables in a car crashes dataset, showing strong positive correlations among most variables except insurance premium and losses, which have negative or moderate correlations with others.
